client.business_model: Multi-state provider of outpatient medication-assisted treatment clinics for opioid and alcohol use disorders
client.client_history: Founded in 2010, SaVida Health has grown from a single clinic to a multi-state platform offering evidence-based opioid and alcohol addiction treatment. Council Capital acquired a controlling interest in 2017, after which the company accelerated its expansion across New England and the Mid-Atlantic.

revenue.notes: No reliable revenue figures located in company documents, official website, LinkedIn, Crunchbase, or reputable news databases.

locations.source: SaVida Health official website – About Us page (accessed 2025-10-28)
locations.notes: Website states the company operates "over 50 outpatient treatment centers." Earlier BHBusiness article (Nov-2020) cited 22 locations. Assuming continued growth, the official site is taken as most current but exact count is not specified.

employees.notes: LeadIQ lists ~165 employees. SignalHire and Indeed give ranges of 100-200 and 51-200 respectively. Using midpoint of most specific figure (LeadIQ).
